sentences.text:
Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 78
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 4217 of 2023
Applicant :- Shashi Kant Srivastava

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajal Krishna

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajesh Kumar Dubey,Vivek Yadav Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed with a prayer to release the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 0408 of 2021, registered under Sections 419, 420, 406, 504, 506, 427 of IPC, Police Station- Colonelganj, District- Prayagraj, during pendency of the trial.

It is alleged in the FIR that applicant being Deputy Director of Apra Buildcon Private Limited,
executed registered sale-deed to different persons after taking money from them.
It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The matter pertains to civil in nature.
He further argued that there is no averment in the FIR regarding alleged plot which is said to be sold to various persons and a vague allegation has been made in the FIR.
There is no shareholding in company.
Applicant had resigned from the company in the year 2017.
Company has executed sale deed in favour of 27 persons.

The applicant Shashi Kant Srivastava vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63861818/
1 has no previous criminal history.

entities.text: Shashi Kant Srivastava vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has implicated in three cases with present case.
There is no evidence to implicate the applicant in the present case.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 30.10.2022.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant but could not dispute the facts argued by the learned counsel for the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Shashi Kant Srivastava, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Rama Kant  Shashi Kant Srivastava vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63861818/
